AUROC is a RANK statistic, so rescaling every score by the same positive constant cannot change it. Renormalising the surviving weights therefore moves the AUROC by exactly 0. What moves it is the REMOVAL of the term. Renormalisation is kept because the brief specifies it and because it keeps the reduced score on a 0-1 scale comparable to the deployed one, which does matter for the tier thresholds.
